description: This Kotlin source file defines the SplashActivity class for an Android app. It implements a splash screen that displays a themed background with the app title, preloads an image into the cache for smooth display, and transitions to the MainActivity after a 3-second delay. The code manages lifecycle safety by removing pending callbacks on destroy to prevent leaks.

classes.name: SplashActivity
classes.description: A lightweight activity serving as a splash screen for an Android TV app, handling initial image caching and transition to main content.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the splash activity, sets layout, preloads cache, and schedules transition to MainActivity after delay.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up scheduled callbacks to prevent memory leaks when the activity is destroyed.
